content: प्रमाणम् .²1 A measure in general (of length, breadth <ab>&c.</ab>); न प्रमाणेन नोत्साहात् सत्त्वस्थो भव पाण्डब <ls>Mb. 3. 33. 63</ls>. (‘प्रमाणं नित्यमर्यादासंघवादिप्रमादिषु’ <ls>Viśva.</ls>); <ls>Mb. 1. 222. 31</ls>; दृष्टो हि वृण्वन् कलभप्रमाणोऽप्याशाः पुरोवातमवाप्य मेघः <ls>R. 18. 38</ls>. .²2 Size, extent, magnitude. .²3 Scale, standard; पृथिव्यां स्वामिभक्तानां प्रमाणे परमे स्थितः <ls>Mu. 2. 21</ls>. .²4 Limit, quantity; वञ्चयित्वा तु राजानं न प्रमाणेऽवतिष्ठसि <ls>Rām. 2. 37. 22</ls>. .²5 Testimony, evidence, proof. .²6 A uthority, warrant; one who judges or decides, one whose word is an authority; श्रुत्वा देवः प्रमाणम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls> ‘having heard this your Majesty will decide (what to do)’; आर्यमिश्राः प्रमाणम् <ls>M. 1</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 1</ls>; सतां हि संदेहपदेषु वस्तुषु प्रमाणमन्तःकरणप्रवृत्तयः <ls>Ś. 1. 22</ls>; व्याकरणे पाणिनिः प्रमाणम्; <ls>Ms. 2. 13</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 240</ls>; sometimes in <ab>pl.</ab>; वेदाः प्रमाणाः. .²7 A true or certain knowledge, accurate conception or notion. .²8 A mode of proof, a means of arriving at correct knowledge; (the Naiyāyikas recognize only four kinds; प्रत्यक्ष, अनुमान, उपमान and शब्द, the Vedāntins and Mimāṃsakas add two more, अनुपलब्धि and अर्थापत्ति; while the Sāṅkhyas admit प्रत्यक्ष, अनुमान and शब्द only; <ab>cf.</ab> अनुभव also.). .²9 Principal, capital. .²10 Unity. .²11 Scripture, sacred authority. .²12 Cause, reason. .²13 Rule, sanction, precept. .²14 The first term in a rule of three. .²15 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²16 Freedom from apprehension. .²17 The prosodial length of a vowel. .²18 An eternal matter; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²19 (In music) A measure (such as द्रुत, मध्य, विलम्बित); <ls>Rām. 1. 4. 8</ls>. .²20 The measure of a square. .{@-णः, -णी@} A rule, standard, authority.
